description: Controlled relation types for assertion subject -> object edges. Closed list: a relation outside it is reported as in_vocabulary=false rather than renamed silently.

reports.description: The subject reports, states or claims the object (the default for a sentence that asserts a result).

measures.description: The subject measures or quantifies the object (a metric, quantity or value).

achieves.description: The subject attains a stated performance, value or condition.

outperforms.description: The subject performs better than the object on a stated metric and setting.

improves_over.description: The subject shows an improvement relative to the object, possibly partial.

equals.description: The subject and object are stated to be equivalent on the stated dimension.

causes.description: The subject is stated to cause or produce the object.

correlates_with.description: The subject is stated to co-vary with the object; no causal claim is made.

predicts.description: The subject is stated to predict the object.

requires.description: The subject is stated to require or depend on the object.

uses.description: The subject uses or is built from the object (method, dataset, component).

trained_on.description: The subject was trained on the object (dataset, corpus, split).

evaluated_on.description: The subject was evaluated on the object (benchmark, dataset, split).

composed_of.description: The subject is composed of the object (architecture, layers, ingredients).

assumes.description: The subject assumes or presupposes the object as a condition.

has_limitation.description: The subject is stated to have the object as a limitation or failure mode.

contradicts.description: The subject contradicts or is incompatible with the object.

derived_from.description: The subject is derived from the object (analysis, transformation, citation).
